posts.author: catenkaa
posts.body:
Hi!  I’m very new to RPG Maker and to these forums, I hope I’m posting this in the right place!
I was following
this
tutorial and tried to download
this
plugin, but when I open the plugin manager to add it to my game it doesn’t appear!  The default plugins that came with RPG Maker MZ show up but not the one I’m looking for.  I made sure to download the js file and put it in the plugins folder of my game and even added a “layers” folder with my art to the img folder but it doesn’t show up at all in my program.
I’m hoping it’s an easy fix beginner mistake.  Any help is appreciated!
Edit:  Turns out I had the plugin downloaded in the wrong game's folder!  I moved it over and it works now

posts.author: Artille
posts.body:
I believe you are referring to the Plugin Manager.
Once you put your plugin in the correct folder : js/plugins/
you need to add it in your plugin manager.
Press F10 (or click on the puzzle icon), then double click on any empty space, which will pop up a new window, in which you can search for your plugins, select it under "Name", let the state set to "ON" and click ok.
It will now appear in your Plugin Manager
The plugin you mentionned is no exception to that rule, so if it does not pop up, make sure it is installed in the correct folder.
Just to be sure, you can select Game => Open Game Folder => go the js/plugins and check if it's there, if it's not, maybe you installed it in another folder.
